MB7071H.read_port: Existing asynchronous port borrowed during held freeze; guest output can change during scanning
MB7071H.response: Registered pre-write value; invalid index returns zero/error and cannot mutate
MB7071H.boundary: Requests ignored while running, entering freeze or releasing. Actual guest edge selected by state_advance.
MB7071H.scope:
Isolated exact-advance/state-access clones of the two async 256-word RAMs.

Freeze borrows the existing asynchronous read address. Outputs can change
during scans, so the caller must hold every consumer and external frontend.
This primitive is not a global pause or a complete machine snapshot.
